$note: The only file allowed to declare Couranr's active authority domains and their
precedence. It owns WHERE truth lives; it never repeats the product facts
themselves. Adding a value here that also exists in a domain source is the
failure this manifest exists to prevent.
Enforced by `npm run check:governance`: every path named here must exist, no
domain may declare two writable sources, and every generated output must
match what its generator produces from its declared authority.

classes.AUTHORITY: Writable source for exactly one declared domain.
classes.GENERATED: Never edited directly; a generator plus a parity check prove it matches its authority.
classes.EVIDENCE: Records what was measured or reviewed at a named SHA. Never overrides authority.
classes.HISTORICAL: Preserved provenance or a superseded plan. Never overrides authority or current state.

excludes: implementation status — lives in the ledgers
visual-source status — lives in the visual authority domain

generated_notes.lib/couranr/screens.ts: Projection of TWO domains: topology from this authority, and the `status` field verbatim from the screen-implementation-state ledger. It is generated rather than read at runtime because Next bundles it. `implemented` is derived from `status`; it used to be a hand-kept boolean that disagreed with the ledger on 15 of 66 screens.

owns: the public composition contract: governed pages, their section rows and their budgets
screen visual-SOURCE status: canonical vs derived, root design exports, nested reference and provenance assets
the repo-root PNG census: one accounted-for entry per root asset, screen mock or not
recorded disputes where the census claim and the provenance claim disagree
excludes: screen topology — lives in the screens-routes domain
verified_views: docs/couranr-mvp/brand/COURANR_VISUAL_SYSTEM_V2_2.md §19 and §27 — hand-written human handbook, checked against this source for drift rather than generated from it

generated_notes.docs/couranr-mvp/MOCK_TO_SCREEN_MAP.md: Root-PNG census REPORT. Every count in its table is derived at render time; it used to assert them in prose.

owns: one row per authoritative work item
platform, dependency, migration-order and rollback baseline

$rule: Every path listed under any domain's `generated` array must contain the marker
string below in its own bytes. A generated file that does not say so is a file
somebody will hand-edit, and the parity check only tells them afterwards.
Enforced by `npm run check:governance`, with a positive control.
HISTORICAL and EVIDENCE files. They record what was planned or what was measured
at a named SHA. Neither states current truth and neither outranks a domain
`check:governance` enforces: every path exists; no path here is also a domain
authority or a generated output; and every HISTORICAL file carries one of the
accepted de-authorization markers near its top, or declares why it cannot.
EVIDENCE is declared by DIRECTORY, not by file. Enumerating evidence files would
make the manifest a second index that goes stale the moment a run writes a new
artifact — and an evidence directory is the one place where new files appearing
without a manifest edit is correct behaviour.

AUTHORITY_MANIFEST.json itself is neither. It is the authority TOPOLOGY — it says where truth lives and holds no product value of its own, which is why nothing in it may repeat a fact a domain source owns.
accepted_markers: This is not a product authority.
